unlisted_practices: Structured, phenotype-rich prompt construction that encodes patient and disease phenotypes, compared with disease labels alone, to improve LLM gene prioritization
Adding an LLM re-ranking layer on top of an existing first-stage gene prioritization pipeline without altering the diagnostic pipeline
ACMG-aligned per-gene reasoning explanations to support clinical review

screen.reason: The study evaluates a novel LLM-based tool (LA-MARRVEL) for rare disease gene prioritization across retrospective patient cohorts, focusing on model architecture and structured prompting accuracy rather than testing organizational deployment practices.
